features.title: Phase-2 declaration layer: 26-class registry + module manifests
features.user_visible_behavior: cli/registry/contribution-points.json defines the 26-class artifact registry; core modules declare module.json; manifest loader validates fail-closed before copy.
features.evidence: 26-class contribution-points.json registry + generators + vocabulary landed; module.json x4; manifest loader/validator fail-closed on unregistered type, kit-internal, engines, escape, contract, mount-collision.

features.title: Wave A: Registry files table as enumeration SoT
features.user_visible_behavior: HARNESS_FILES, BINDINGS, FOLDER_READMES, SELF_COPIES, installAgentsCore, and installDocsRoot derive from registry files[]; enableOne is manifest-driven.
features.evidence: Wave A landed: registry files[] is the enumeration SoT; hardcoded arrays replaced with registry derivations; enableOne manifest-driven (switch deleted).

features.title: Wave B: Ignore, stamp, runtime, and retired enumerations derive from registry
features.user_visible_behavior: COMMITTED_PATHS, RUNTIME_PATHS, RUNTIMES, RUNTIME_DIRS, KIT_TOOL_SERVERS, and RETIRED_* derive from contribution-points.json.
features.evidence: Wave B landed: ignore/stamp/runtime/retired enumerations derived from registry; runtimes/committed_checks/retired sections added to contribution-points.json.

features.title: Wave C: Dynamic vocabulary-driven PHASES/modes and commands section
features.user_visible_behavior: PHASES and SLICE_MODES derive from registry vocabulary; commands section drives HARNESS_COMMANDS and KIT_COMMANDS.
features.evidence: Wave C landed: PHASES and SLICE_MODES derive dynamically from registry vocabulary; commands section in registry drives dispatcher tables.

features.title: Wave D: Generated-state migration and .gitattributes/.gitignore generation
features.user_visible_behavior: Global state/manifest.json retired in favor of registry.json; 42 generated files untracked; .gitattributes and .gitignore rules generated from registry.
features.evidence: Wave D landed: global state/manifest.json retired; readers read generated registry.json; .gitattributes and .gitignore generated from registry attribute_globs and ignore_patterns.

features.title: Wave E: Generator umbrella asdd kit regen & guardrails
features.user_visible_behavior: asdd kit regen runs registered generators; checkExecutableShape validates adapter exports; G-16 source_root invariant enforced; DOM-11 re-pinned.
features.evidence: Wave E landed: asdd kit regen umbrella over registry generators; G-13/D-7 checkExecutableShape; AR-3 session naming lint; G-16 source_root invariant enforced fail-closed; DOM-11 profiling citations re-pinned.
